messages:
maria_csm: Quick heads-up - NorthHarbor renewal needs the invoice to read 'NorthHarbor EU Operations' and they want delegated signing from their procurement contact. CFO out Thurs-Fri.
tariq_cs: Do we have the new billing legal name and EU VAT? Also: will the delegated sign require a PO amendment?
paul_finance: Billing name confirmed: NorthHarbor EU Operations Ltd. VAT: GB123456789. PO: NH-2024-EU-77. We need billing contact email for invoice. Also need to confirm if VAT reverse-charge applies.
elain_e_legal: Looping in: if the billing entity changes on an amendment, we add an "Entity Change" clause and a billing effective date. Delegated signer ok if they provide a delegation letter. Add "delegation reference" to signature block.
omar_sales: Customer provided a scanned delegation letter and a procurement contact name: Petra Novak <petra@northharbor.eu>. Petra will sign first. CFO will only countersign after they return but the customer says countersign is not required for execution.
maria_csm: Can we do Docusign routing: Petra -> Finance (paul_finance) -> Legal (elaine_legal)? Need the envelope to include a checkbox: "I confirm I am authorized per delegation letter".
docusign_bot: Created envelope env_NH_5566. Routing: procurement_petru -> paul_finance -> elaine_legal. Checkbox placeholder added on page 1. Link: https://docusign.example/env/env_NH_5566
tariq_cs: Also customer requests to keep Dedicated KMS enabled and provide key fingerprint in the contract. Will that change anything?
elain_e_legal: Add KMS key fingerprint in section 5.1. No change to sign flow. Just ensure we store the key id text verbatim.
paul_finance: Pricing note: customer chose 9-month commitment at discounted seat count. Prorated total = EUR 48,200. Invoice will be net 30 to the EU entity, include VAT field (zero-rated if reverse-charge).
maria_csm: Copying the internal checklist: 1) attach delegation letter to envelope 2) update amendment with entity + KMS fingerprint 3) invoice template + VAT fields 4) send envelope today to avoid delaying onboarding next Tue.
omar_sales: Customer asked whether onboarding can start before CFO signs. We said yes after procurement signs. Please confirm.
elain_e_legal: That's acceptable provided the delegation letter grants authority to bind. Keep a copy in contract folder.
docusign_bot: Envelope env_NH_5566 updated with amendment_v2.pdf and delegation_letter.pdf. Status: ready_to_send.
paul_finance: Uploaded invoice template with VAT placeholder and billing contact: sara.accounts@northharbor.eu.
docusign_bot: Envelope sent to procurement_petru at 2024-06-20T09:18:00Z.
docusign_bot: Signature recorded: procurement_petru signed at 2024-06-20T10:02:37Z. Next: paul_finance.
paul_finance: Signed and attached final invoice PDF.
docusign_bot: Signature recorded: paul_finance signed at 2024-06-20T10:25:11Z. Next: elaine_legal.
elain_e_legal: Quick edit requested: change "billing effective on signature" to "billing effective on execution date". Left a comment in the envelope.
docusign_bot: Comment acknowledged. Document updated to amendment_v3.pdf.
elain_e_legal: Signed at 2024-06-20T10:43:55Z. Envelope completed. Final doc: https://docusign.example/env/env_NH_5566/final.pdf
omar_sales: Customer confirmed they uploaded VAT docs to their procurement portal and requested invoice be sent to sara.accounts@northharbor.eu.
maria_csm: Renewal executed. I'm updating the renewal tracker and scheduling onboarding kickoff for 2024-06-25. Thanks all. :rocket:
